name: phone-frame
title: PhoneFrame
description: Decorative chrome that mocks a phone shell for marketing / showcase / docs. Renders the device silhouette (notch, Dynamic Island, home indicator, status bar slot) and clips its child to the screen bounds. Three platforms — ios-notch, ios-island (Dynamic Island), android-pin-hole. Distinct from the iOS / Android platform docs — PhoneFrame is presentation, not runtime.
